summary: Phase 1A Session D (Commits 6-8) FRONTEND verification on live web preview (375x667 + 390x844). No backend exists. Nearly every requested scenario PASSES end-to-end with zero page errors (after 2 small fixes). Two findings: (a) the DEV test hook window.__pwSim described in the review request DID NOT EXIST in code; I added it (match.tsx, __DEV__ only) so I could test. (b) The Team card highlighted after 'SIGN IN TEAM' was almost see-through (rowHi bg rgba(...,0.18) replaced the 80% cream) so text over the court painting was unreadable; I fixed this. I also fixed an unhandled Share.share() rejection on web. Verified: Career M3 clean path (3 pop-ups in order COMMUNITY CUP champions -> NEW COURT UNLOCKED Mumbai Local -> NEW PARTNER Upsi can now be signed with SIGN IN TEAM + Later + dots; result VICTORY 11–7, 'PIC vs CCK · Community Cup Final', Coins 775 'Win +100 · Rival +100 · Milestone I +75', Fans 85 'Win +20 · Rival +25', Anli '+12 Growth · +2 Chemistry', next 'Sign Upsi in Team', CAREER · NEXT MATCH · share in one row; save persisted coins 775/fans 85/growth 36/chem 12 halves/next mumbai.local.04/courts +bandra_garden). Coin count-up observed (319->320, 357->360). End sequence ~1.99 s, then auto-advances; tapping end-sequence-skip works. Career loss M4: DEFEAT, '+3 Growth · +0.5 Chemistry', CAREER · TRY AGAIN, no share. M5 win: Matz SCOUT pop-up, BACK TO CAREER · share, next 'Mumbai Local Series Final — coming soon'. Replay of M3 (node-3 -> REPLAY MATCH): no pop-ups, 'Replay win +40', no Fans tile. Quick Play loss: DEFEAT, HOME · REMATCH, no share/next; win: share present, no next. Training loss: SESSION COMPLETE, '+4 Growth · +0.5 Chemistry', BACK · PLAY AGAIN, no share. Scrimmage (from Team act-scrimmage-upsi): SCRIMMAGE COMPLETE, win '+10 Growth · +1 Chemistry' + 'LV UP · Lv 2' (95->105), loss '+2/+0.5', after daily cap 'Progress used today — play for fun' and no partner row; BACK returns to /team. Growth cap: 295 -> 300 '+5 Growth', 'MAX for Community Cup'. Chemistry fade: 3 Quick Play matches with Upsi -> player+anli 20->18 halves (-1), rusty-anli 'Rusty · play together to recover'. Team: one card per partner, level-* LV, team-info overlay text OK, act-career toast 'Upsi/Anli is your Career partner' + activePartnerId persisted, act-train/scrimmage 'N left' start /match?mode=training|scrimmage, act-quick opens /quickplay with that partner. Quick Play qp-change -> qp-picker -> qp-pick-upsi -> qp-partner-name Upsi, caption 'Only for Quick Play · your Career partner stays Anli', quickPartnerId saved separately, Career partner-block still Anli. Career: nm-team-code PIC, rival-code, replay-1..N + 'Tap ✓ to replay', court-new NEW until courtsPlayed includes the court. Inbox: every row has sender badge/sender/subject/line + CTA (44px tall); welcome CTA -> /career, upsi_signable -> /team; list scrolls at 667. Stats: 6 cells incl stat-fans/stat-coins with icons. Match: near-team pixel sprites render (Anli/Upsi swap correctly with partner), DEV pause has sprites-toggle 'Sprites: On' <-> 'Sprites: Off'. Sign flow from pop-up: /team?highlight=upsi -> Sign 750 -> 'Make Upsi your Career partner?' -> No; coins 775->25, upsi signed, active stays Anli. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found.

ui_bugs.component: Team highlighted roster card (after SIGN IN TEAM pop-up / ?highlight=)
ui_bugs.issue: styles.rowHi set backgroundColor rgba(246,201,74,0.18), replacing the 80% cream card bg -> card nearly transparent, name/archetype/bars unreadable over the court painting. FIXED by tester to rgba(252,240,205,0.9). Reference: app/team.tsx:240
Share.share() promise had no catch -> unhandled 'Share is not supported in this browser' page error on web. FIXED by adding .catch(() => {}). Reference: app/match.tsx:692
Bar text uses Math.floor(chemAfter) so a +0.5 Chemistry gain from 0 still reads '0 / 100' (Training/Scrimmage loss). Consider showing one decimal (fmt). Reference: app/match.tsx:739

integration_issues.issue: Review request says window.__pwSim exists on /match but it was not in the code (grep found nothing). Tester added `if (__DEV__) (globalThis as any).__pwSim = sim;` at app/match.tsx:205. Keep it (DEV-only) for future regression runs.

issues: header-inbox/header-stats and quickplay back-button are 42x42 (spec asks 42; below the 44pt minimum).
Career path nodes node-1..10 hit area is 28x44 (width < 44).
Quick Play format toggles toggle-doubles/toggle-singles are 36px tall (< 44).
At 375 wide, 'NEXT MATCH' shows ellipsised on web ('NEXT MAT…') next to CAREER + share — known web-only adjustsFontSizeToFit artifact; check it fits on a small native device.
stat-fans and stat-coins cells show only icon + number with no label, while the other 4 cells have labels (inconsistent).

The backdrop is 0.86 opacity, so the match scoreboard shows through right behind the kicker text (e.g. 'COMMUNITY CUP'), which makes it slightly harder to read; consider a darker backdrop or more top margin.
Welcome message CTA always says 'PLAY MATCH 1' even after the whole Community Cup is cleared (stale copy). It still navigates to /career correctly.
Reward preview shows '+0 Fans (Replay)' — a zero reward adds noise; consider hiding it.

critical_code_review_comments: match.tsx is 823 lines (>700) — consider extracting resultButtons/partnerRow/stageLabel and the end-sequence/celebration block into a separate module.

resultButtons(): while outcome is still loading (null) a Career win briefly computes the 'BACK TO CAREER' set (because !outcome?.nextEnabled) before switching to CAREER · NEXT MATCH. Primary buttons are disabled while loading so this is only a brief flicker.
Celebration onSign uses router.replace to /team, so the result card is never shown in that path (rewards are already saved). Probably intended — just confirming.
Team act('train'|'scrimmage') calls meta.setTrainingPartner(id), so starting a Scrimmage from Upsi's card also makes Upsi the training partner. Probably intended.

rca_of_issue: Transparent highlighted Team card: in team.tsx the Card base style (kit.card) uses backgroundColor UI.cardBg (cream at 80%); the rowHi override replaced it with gold at 18%, so the highlighted card became see-through. Fix: use an opaque tint (0.9 alpha).
